name: Kay Prashad
bio:
Kay Prashad leads cybersecurity at one of the most consequential levels, protecting the systems that keep the financial world moving. As a leader in the space, she is responsible for services that protect critical infrastructure.

But her path to this role wasn't built on technology alone—it was built on learning how to translate complexity into clarity.

Early in her career, she found herself at the intersection of business and technology, helping organizations navigate change long before cybersecurity became a boardroom priority. Over time, that foundation evolved into leading large-scale transformations, bringing together fragmented security teams, aligning them to business priorities, and helping organizations move from reactive defense to proactive resilience.

Today, she works closely with executive leadership, regulators, and global financial partners to address one of the most pressing challenges of our time: how to protect critical systems in an increasingly interconnected and high-risk world.

Known for her ability to make cybersecurity accessible and actionable, Kay brings a grounded, real-world perspective to her speaking, cutting through the noise to focus on what actually matters: protecting people, institutions, and the systems we all depend on.
